data.body_html:
Imagine a perfect day on the Mediterranean with your family—cruising from Puerto Banús, stopping to snorkel in crystal-clear coves, riding a jetski, and paddling a SUP under the Spanish sun. The Marbella family boat day 2042 package combines all these activities into one seamless charter, starting from just €749 for two hours on a luxury motor yacht. Whether you choose the Astondoa 40 or the Azimut 39, everything is included: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and all the water toys. No hidden costs, no stress—just quality time together.

What’s Included in Your Family Boat Day

Every charter comes with a licensed skipper, full fuel, insurance, and 21% Spanish VAT. Onboard, you’ll find unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. For the Tier A boats, we provide a jetski, snorkel masks and fins, and a paddleboard at no extra charge. The Mangusta 80 upgrade also includes a jetski. Safety equipment, life jackets for all ages, and basic instruction are all part of the package.

Choose Your Yacht: Astondoa 40 vs Azimut 39

Both boats are 12.5 metres long, ideal for families. The Astondoa 40 accommodates up to 9 guests, while the Azimut 39 sleeps 11. Both depart from Puerto Banús and offer spacious sundecks, a shaded cockpit, and a toilet onboard. If you have a larger group or want extra luxury, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours—and includes a jetski. For pricing on other yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Pershing 46, contact us via WhatsApp.

Sample Itinerary: 8-Hour Family Day

  • 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board your yacht, safety briefing
  • 10:30 – Cruise east towards Cabopino, spotting La Concha mountain
  • 11:30 – Anchor at Cala del Faro for snorkelling and paddleboarding
  • 13:00 – Lunch onboard (bring your own or enjoy included snacks)
  • 14:30 – Jetski session in the bay (supervised by skipper)
  • 16:00 – Relaxed cruise back to Puerto Banús, drinks served
  • 18:00 – Disembark

Water Toys for All Ages

The jetski is easy to ride and perfect for teenagers and adults. Snorkel gear lets you explore rocky coves like Cala Cortés, where fish are abundant. The paddleboard is stable enough for kids to try—life jackets are mandatory for non-swimmers. All equipment is cleaned and maintained after each use. The crew will give a quick demo so everyone feels confident.

Why Book with Boat Rental Marbella?

We are a local operator based in Puerto Banús, not an affiliate. Our fleet is real, our prices are transparent, and our skippers know the coast intimately. You’ll never encounter hidden fees or inflated fuel surcharges. We focus on family-friendly experiences, and our 2042 package is designed to give you the best value for a full day of water fun. Check out our main page for more charter options.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in the Marbella family boat day 2042 package?

Your charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT. For the Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39), a jetski, snorkel gear, and a paddleboard are provided at no extra cost.

You can book a 2-hour trip for €749 or a full 8-hour day for €2,299 on either the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a jetski.

Yes, the paddleboard is stable and suitable for children under adult supervision. Life jackets are provided for all ages, and the crew can give basic instructions. It’s a fun, gentle activity for the whole family.
